# WalPanel Inc.

> Architectural WPC (wood-plastic composite) wall cladding and modular fence panels, stocked locally at a by-appointment showroom in Chatsworth, Los Angeles. Serving Los Angeles, Santa Monica, Burbank, Glendale, Encino, Sherman Oaks and the San Fernando Valley. Sells to homeowners and contractors with same-day/next-day pickup and ~60-mile delivery.

## Products
- [WPC Cladding Boards](https://walpanelinc.com/cladding.html): HLC-49 series architectural composite wall cladding, 8-5/8" wide, in 108" and 114" lengths, stocked colors from $35.36 per board (~$5.90/sq ft material).
- [WPC Fence Panel Kits](https://walpanelinc.com/fence.html): Modular 6 ft x 6 ft composite fence sections with aluminum top rail and hardware included, $248 per set; extra posts $90.

## Pricing and guides
- [Get a Quote](https://walpanelinc.com/quote.html): Instant WPC cladding and fence estimate calculator.
- [WPC Cladding & Fence Cost Guide — Los Angeles, 2026](https://walpanelinc.com/cost-guide.html): Material vs. installed cost ranges for composite cladding and fencing.
- [WPC vs Trex vs Wood](https://walpanelinc.com/wpc-vs-trex.html): Material comparison for cladding and fence projects.

## Notes
- Service area: Los Angeles, Santa Monica and the San Fernando Valley, ~60-mile delivery radius from Chatsworth, CA 91311.
- Payment: Zelle or cash; 9.75% California sales tax applied at checkout.
- WalPanel Inc. is the local retail arm of Wallshell (architectural composite specialist, est. 2002).
